cases.name: update_frontmatter preserves unrelated fields and updates managed keys
cases.input:
---
title: Example
summary: old
tags:
  - alpha
author: Jane
---
Body.
cases.output:
---
title: Example
summary: new summary
tags:
  - beta
  - gamma
author: Jane
concepts:
  - one
related:
  - Notes/Other.md
---
Body.

cases.name: update_frontmatter clears summary/tags for Apple annotation notes
cases.input:
---
title: Annotation
type: apple-books-annotation
summary: old
tags:
  - alpha
---
Quote body.
cases.output:
---
title: Annotation
type: apple-books-annotation
concepts:
  - '[[One]]'
related:
  - '[[Notes/Other|Other]]'
---
Quote body.
